title: Zombie dreams
content: I (36f) don’t dream very often, but when I do it’s always involving zombies or other situations where my life is in danger. I am always on high alert, looking for someone I love who I’ve “lost”, and fighting the zombies with whatever weapons my dream offers that night. I’ve even had dreams of flying zombies, but I was able to fly too … and see the world from above but because of my deep fear in these dreams, I’m never able to remember much besides being scared to get bit/killed. I just wanted to see if anyone else has similar dreams?
